messages:
elaine.ops: RCA published: https://internal.redwood/rca/1778004567. Brief: a config drift in the routing table caused cross-region traffic to be routed to a decommissioned pool. Impact window ~18m; customer-facing rate limits hit for some tenants. Full timeline, logs, and mitigations in the doc. Action table at the bottom — please pick or ack items you own by EOD.

incident-bot: Auto-timeline: 09:02 deploy -> 09:07 5xx surge -> 09:10 routing errors start -> 09:15 partial mitigation (route override) -> 09:20 full mitigation (rollback & route repair) -> 09:20 service normalized. Correlation traces attached.

rico.eng: Thanks @elaine.ops. I'll take Action A: "add deployment-time routing verification". Plan: add pre-deploy sanity check + integration test. ETA: Wed 2024-02-07. Will post PR when ready.

tasha.sre: I'll own Action B: "automate route-health alerting". I'll add synthetic checks and a playbook for failover to the secondary pool. Proposal: checkpoint Thurs 2024-02-08 10:00 PT.

ben.cs: Need a one-paragraph note for account teams. @sara.prod can you draft and include impact phrasing and recommended customer messaging? We should avoid technical detail but be explicit about mitigation and next steps.

sara.prod: On it. Drafting now, will drop in this thread by EOD for review. Should we include an FAQ section?

elaine.ops: Yes please include FAQ with timeline, what we fixed, what we're doing to prevent recurrence, and who to contact. Office hours to review RCA + actions: Fri 2024-02-02 09:30 PT (calendar invite sent).

rico.eng: Quick note: I'll add a unit test that asserts routing table includes only active pools and add a small e2e in staging.

tasha.sre: I'll also add a runbook step to verify route table post-deploy and wire it into the deploy job.

ben.cs: Draft received from @sara.prod — posting here for review: "We experienced a brief service disruption affecting API requests for select accounts. The issue was caused by stale routing configuration during a rollout and has been resolved. No customer data was affected. Our engineers have implemented checks and are adding further guardrails; we'll keep you updated." Any edits?

sara.prod: That reads well. Suggest adding "expected to be deployed by next week" line about the checks.

elaine.ops: Two asks: 1) Owners, react with :white_check_mark: to accept; 2) If you need more time, reply with new ETA. We'll compile a short CSM note after the office hours.

rico.eng: \u2705

tasha.sre: \u2705 (checkpoint ok)

ben.cs: \u2705 — will coordinate with CSMs after office hours.

sara.prod: \u2705 — will post final customer note in #customers once approved.

elaine.ops: Thanks. Reminder that follow-up verification will include a one-week watch with daily health digests. Please add any follow-up evidence (PRs, alert screenshots, test runs) back into this thread so I can close the action items. If anything urgent comes up, escalate in #eng-oncall.
